title: Data Engineer
description:
• Job Title: Data Engineer
  • Type: Full Time, Permanent
  • Salary: £73,000 - £80,000 depending on experience
  • Location: EcoPark, Edmonton North London


About LondonEnergy:

LondonEnergy operates the second largest waste contract in the UK, handling and processing nearly 750,000 tonnes of London's waste every year. We have a dedicated team of people working across our various North London sites, making a positive difference to the environment and the local community.

By processing household waste at our facility, we produce enough waste from energy to power 80,000 homes every year and recycle 70% of items through our Reuse and Recycling Centres.


About the role:

We are seeking an experienced Data Engineer to design, implement and maintain scalable data and analytics solutions that support our business intelligence, operational and reporting needs. This is a key role in shaping our data and analytics strategy, ensuring the integrity, availability, quality and security of our data assets.

The initial focus will be on maintaining and upgrading an existing solution to meet DEFRA's Digital Waste Tracking Service requirements. This will involve designing and implementing API-based integrations to enable reliable, automated data exchange between internal systems and DEFRA.

Over time, the role will expand to improving the flow, integration and modelling of operational, plant and asset data from on-premises systems into the Microsoft Azure and Fabric ecosystem. This will support enhanced reporting, regulatory compliance, business intelligence and analytics, while enabling more automated, efficient and data-driven operations across future facilities.


Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop and maintain robust, scalable and secure data and analytics architecture across cloud environments, with a focus on Microsoft Azure and Fabric.
  • Establish and promote data architecture best practices, leveraging AI to automate data management, processing and optimisation.
  • Develop and maintain enterprise data models, architecture standards, Master Data Management (MDM) and data governance solutions.
  • Design, develop and optimise data pipelines and ETL processes, ensuring data quality, consistency, performance, security and regulatory compliance.
  • Evaluate emerging data technologies, tools and platforms, recommending solutions to support the organisation's evolving data strategy.
  • Collaborate with technical teams, business analysts and stakeholders to gather requirements and translate business needs into standardised, accessible, interoperable and reusable data solutions.
  • Drive continuous improvement by monitoring data tool adoption, identifying opportunities for optimisation and contributing to the future roadmap for data training, support and capability development.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline.
  • 6+ years' experience in Data Architecture, Data Engineering, or a similar role.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure, Microsoft Fabric, cloud data platforms and data warehousing solutions.
  • Proven experience designing and implementing API solutions using Microsoft Logic Apps and other integration tools, supported by strong technical skills in software engineering, SQL, Python and data modelling.
  • Good understanding of data governance, security, compliance, Master Data Management (MDM) and data cataloguing tools.
  • Knowledge or experience in AI Solution Architecture would be a significant advantage. Data Architecture or Data Management certifications (e.g. TOGAF, DAMA) are desirable.
  • Excellent problem-solving, communication, collaboration and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to operate in a low-data-maturity environment and lead, influence and support others through change.
  • Please note, you need to be in the office at least 2 days per week.

Benefits

  • Private Medical & Life Insurance
  • Company Pension Scheme
  • Annual Leave Package
  • Employee Recognition Scheme
  • Access to Employee Assistance Programme (EAP)
  • + Many more benefits


Early application is encouraged as we will review applications throughout the advertising period and reserve the right to close the advert early.
